passages.text: In patients undergoing PCI, new-generation DES should be used in preference to BMS. Synthetic v2 test passage; evaluate bleeding and stent thrombosis risk.
OCT is a reasonable alternative, except in ostial left main disease.
For patients with elevated high-sensitivity cardiac troponin I (hs-cTnI), serial monitoring and renal creatinine baseline verification are recommended.
